The nurse fixated on my weight and launched into a patronising lecture about carbohydrates and sugar, including sitting and showing me pictures of jacket potatoes while warning me that I “need to watch out.” This was entirely unsolicited — I attended for a brief routine check-up, not dietary counselling.

I explained that I am actively working with a personal trainer, that my body measurements are reducing, and that I am making structured, healthy changes to my diet. This information was dismissed, including eye-rolling and other non-verbal reactions, leaving me feeling unheard and belittled. This is unacceptable in a healthcare setting.

This was not supportive or patient-centred health advice. It was delivered without any awareness of how harmful such an approach can be, particularly towards young women. For patients with a history of disordered eating, interactions like this are not merely upsetting — they are actively dangerous.

I left the appointment feeling judged, undermined, and distressed. A medical professional should be capable of listening to the patient in front of them and practising with basic professionalism and sensitivity. This experience fell well below that standard.

To note, this has occurred on multiple occasions. Despite raising concerns with reception and requesting a note on my record to avoid this nurse in future, I was told I had no alternative — it would be “her or nothing.” I find this deeply concerning and very disappointing.",null,[0,239]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toV1FYVlZMVVF3YkU5WGQxSmtTVEJaTmpWdllXYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x16872d5fc68f38bb!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkhWQXVVLUQwbE9Xd1JkSTBZNjVvYWc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toV1FYVlZMVVF3YkU5WGQxSmtTVEJaTmpWdllXYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjfz8P4-LeTAxURMnsEHclKEbsQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjfz8P4-LeTAxURMnsEHclKEbsQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUZNYWxWZlgxOWZSV2hDZWtSNk9VaHZhalZsYVRGMU9XOVBZMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSYzBOYVFqRXlUa1JqV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2swMlV6azFZWEpFU2todk9EWlJUbE5pZDJaQlUwRRAB",["0x0:0x16872d5fc68f38bb",null,1761818203807060,1761818203807060,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/115096448015340343063/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Spencer This surgery is, without doubt, the worst I have ever been with and I know from conversations with others in the community that my experience is far from unique.

Gaslighting vulnerable patients appears to be a regular occurrence, and genuine willingness to help is often absent. When concerns are raised, the practice manager responds with hostility, making me feel as though I do not deserve medical care at all. In particular, she displays a consistently hostile and bullying attitude towards patients, which is utterly unacceptable in a healthcare setting.  After I made an official complaint, it became clear that every interaction and request for treatment was scrutinised, with access to medication and support made unnecessarily difficult leaving me with very limited access to care from them. I have not had an appointment with them for over a year now which is horrendous for someone who is housebound with complex pain medical conditions

The behaviour of one GPs is particularly alarming. I have had to report him to the GMC for inappropriate and harmful conduct, including telling me during a consultation for a mental health crisis that “if you lost some weight you would feel better about yourself." This is not only unprofessional but extremely damaging and has stayed with me every day since. He has also placed an unfounded “diagnosis” on my records, refused to remove it despite GDPR concerns, and has interfered in my care when specifically asked not to.

Confidentiality cannot be trusted either, as medical records are shared inappropriately with administrative staff and individuals outside the practice. Requests for help with severe anxiety were met with suggestions to reduce medication rather than provide meaningful support.

This practice has the facilities to be excellent, but major changes in staffing and attitude are urgently required. Until then, patients should be prepared for dismissive, hostile, and inhumane treatment.
A patient should not have to make any complaint to the GMC & PHSO due to conduct and patient privacy.",null,[0,234]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJa2VHeUlBEAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x16872d5fc68f38bb!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgMDIkeGyIA%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJa2VHeUlBEAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJa2VHeUlBEiYKF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdNRElrZUd5b0FFEgswY2RDS09FOUxYdRotChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJa2VHeVlBEhNDZ3dJa1A3ZnZ3WVFvTEt4cWdNIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARuziPxl8thxYqCzBjZENLT0U5TFh1&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjfz8P4-LeTAxURMnsEHclKEbsQoykIFigB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwjfz8P4-LeTAxURMnsEHclKEbsQ0pMFCBQoBg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUo2Tm10ZlgxOWZSV2hCVUVoeGVtVXllbTAzUVc1U1NuUndiMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpuYjBOYWVuZGxiVEZyV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tkcVdGTnJkbmRXTmswMU5FeEtUVzQzVDNaU1UzYxAB",["0x0:0x16872d5fc68f38bb",null,1765291638278652,1765291638278652,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106127760839566727279/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Billy
